Card Q&A.a: Yes, either can be unsuspended or suspended.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to unsuspend or suspend either my Digimon or my opponent's Digimon?

Effect: {Hand} [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may unsuspend 1 Digimon. Then, you may suspend 1 Digimon.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your [Ver.5] trait Digimon suspend, ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
